version: B award SDRAM alignment and A live spotlight diagnostic

diagnosis.reproduced_contract: Existing read calibration: raw SDRAM data leads valid by one memory clock.
diagnosis.before: B award reads bypassed the capture register. Shifted light pointers/bitmaps can pass link CRC because corruption precedes CRC generation.
diagnosis.after: B applies its existing capture register to award words in both color settings. A exposes light error and field counter.
diagnosis.scope_limit: Simulation reproduction and placed/routed timing are verified; physical-board confirmation is still required.

A_display.E: hex light error: 0 OK, 2 pointer, 3 bitmap, 4 decoder FSM, 7 missing row deadline
A_display.FF: hex spotlight field 00..77, advances every three display frames; KEY2 pauses/resumes
A_display.priority: Earlier transfer/startup faults retain priority over live spotlight status.

programming: Program the named bitstream into its corresponding A/B board. PROGRAM_SRAM must be repeated after a power cycle.
preserved: Trophy pixels and 120 lossless light fields, eleven transitions/dwell water, audio, RGB precision, CRC/markers, all clocks and FIFO depths.
